text: Two Supreme Court orders on 19 Nov for homebuyers paying loans on stalled projects. Sonipat: no coercive recovery by SBI until the commercial court checks whether the bank paid the builder as the three-way loan deal said, and whether buyers really defaulted. Bengaluru: no coercive measures against about 4,500 buyers till they get their flats. Per Business Standard, Bar and Bench and PTI. Who should carry the risk when a project stalls?
